correctness.rationale: For real uniform finite-atom ℓ4, Hλ=λ∑x_j^4−∑(R_nx)_j^4 is homogeneous symmetric degree four. Riener Theorem 1.3 rigorously reduces nonnegativity to ≤2 distinct coordinate values, so projective branches F_{n,k}(t) exhaust the operator norm. Independently expanded the general U′V−UV′ symbolic factorization; residual is identically zero in independent SymPy for symbolic n,k,t, so extrema occur at Q_{n,k}=0, t=1,∞. For n4 verifies factorization and C4=√2. For n8 other k branches ≤4 while k1 branch has unique global negative maximizing root of t⁴−7t³−7t−35 and C8≈1.54452109. Pearson moment inequality gives global fourth-power bound 3+2√2; equality requires a two-point law with irrational mass (3−√6)/6. Compactness on finite uniform atoms makes each inequality strict; rational approximants give convergence.
residual_risks: The two-point reduction uses an external published half-degree theorem; it is appropriate for symmetric quartics but not a self-contained new proof of that theorem.
